description: January 15 birthday meaning: Capricorn decan 3, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a January 15 birthday falls in Capricorn, in the third decan, with Saturn as the sign's ruler and Mercury as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Capricorn is cardinal and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a January 15 birthday
paragraphs: Picture a household spreadsheet kept with real affection: that is roughly the tone of January 15. The 15 reduces to 6, numerology's number of care, and Capricorn's Mercury decan brings organisation to it. Around twenty-four degrees of the sign, the tradition describes someone who shows love by planning, budgeting and keeping promises.

By noon UTC on January 15, the Sun has normally reached roughly 24° of Capricorn. That places the date in the Capricorn decan that astrologers give to Mercury, the third of three. Mercury, ruler of Virgo, colours the last decan of Capricorn, from roughly January 11 to January 20. The sign's practical ambition is joined by a sharp, analytical mind. These natives are often described as strategists and problem-solvers who plan carefully, communicate clearly and spot the weak point in a proposal before anyone else does. Their humour can be dry and well timed. Mercury adds a restlessness that may show up as worry about details or overwork. When this decan trusts the thinking it has already done, it tends to make decisions that others recognise as sound only later.

sections.heading: Numerology of the January 15 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 15th, the compound 1 + 5 reduces to 6, so the birthday number is 6. Here the 1's self-reliance and the 5's curiosity pour into the 6's caring, responsible nature. People with this birthday are often described as warm, magnetic and generous, with an adventurous side that keeps their care from becoming heavy. They may be drawn to roles where they look after others while still having room to move, such as teaching, hosting or creative work for families. As a supporting influence, the 15th tends to show in a lively, affectionate presence.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same January 15 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 7 for 1980, 8 for 1990, 9 for 2000 and 1 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: January 15 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 15 is the 15th day of the year. In most years Aquarius season is under way by January 21, 6 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology counts the year from Lunar New Year, never earlier than January 21, so a January 15 birthday belongs to the animal of the year before the birth year. January 15 is also the birthday of Martin Luther King Jr. (1929), Gamal Abdel Nasser (1918) and Giorgia Meloni (1977).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 15?
faq.answer: January 15 is Capricorn in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Capricorn, which tradition links with Mercury.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 15?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 15 the Life Path is 5 in 1960, 6 in 1970, 7 in 1980, 8 in 1990, 9 in 2000, 1 in 2010 and 11 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 15th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 15?
faq.answer: In the Chinese zodiac a January 15 birth comes before the new year has turned, so the animal is the one that began the previous winter.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 15?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a January 15 birthday are Martin Luther King Jr. (1929), Gamal Abdel Nasser (1918) and Giorgia Meloni (1977). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
